info.title: FlowCatalyst Function Platform API
info.description: The function-platform surface: `/api/functions…`, `/api/function-pools`, `/api/function-policies…`, `/api/function-domains…`, `/api/function-routes`, and the function-host control plane under `/control/functions/…`. Hand-authored (spec `docs/spec/function-openapi.md`) — Java-first, outside `openapi.lock.json` (there is no Go for this surface). NOT here: the invocation surface itself, `/functions/{address}[:{version}]/{path}` on a function host (a passthrough to the function's own endpoints, `docs/spec/function-invocation.md`), and the platform's main API, served at `/api/openapi.json`.

FunctionPageResponse.description: The offset-paginated envelope shared by every list route (apicommon.OffsetPage).

SignerResponse.description: A recorded publish signer identity (VersionResponse.SignerResponse / DesiredState.SignerView — same wire shape).

PublishManifestRequest.description: The publish-time manifest, as parsed by Manifest#parseStrict — only runtime/entrypoint are mandatory, everything else defaults.

Manifest.description: The resolved manifest as the server writes it back (Manifest#toJson) — every key always present.

VersionResponse.description: The list shape omits `manifest`; the single-GET shape (`getFunctionVersion`) adds it.

DeclaredByEntry.description: One manifest that contributed to `declared`/`missing`: `keys` is that manifest's own full key list, not only the keys it added beyond another entry.

updatedAt.description: absent on the effective-default shape, which has no stored row
